description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_function_sugar_email_btn' that generates an email button HTML snippet based on user preferences within the SuiteCRM application. It checks the current user's email link type preference and returns corresponding HTML for either a 'mailto' link or a PDF email button.

methods.name: smarty_function_sugar_email_btn
methods.description: Generates an email button HTML snippet based on user preferences for email link type in SuiteCRM.
